decisions.reason: The source changes only the Hero V's width, elongation, and visual presence; it does not alter the deferred E and L construction requirements.
The accent's requirement to derive from and correspond to the Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a separate new accent rule.
The closing V's relational requirement to use the Hero V's shared geometry remains unchanged despite refinement of the Hero V's proportions.
The source concerns the Hero V's silhouette and presence and does not change the deferred champagne-metal material direction or its application constraint.
The Hero V proportion change does not necessarily alter the deferred requirement that the complete wordmark read as one cohesive mark.
